title: FABER WG4.3 - multiaxial fatigue assessment library
description: A collaborative Python library and method catalogue supporting comparison and a scientific review of multiaxial fatigue criteria. Current calculations use single-frequency harmonic stress cycles for plain or smooth geometries, elastic strain estimates, damage parameters, and life fitting where applicable.
access_label: Public repository; licence not yet selected
scope_note: Active development. Some methods are partial or require review; independent validation against published or experimental datasets remains outstanding. Variable-amplitude histories, notch gradients and constitutive plasticity are future work. The review article is in preparation.

title: FABEST High-Cycle Fatigue Competition: Participant Package for Blind Fatigue-Life Prediction
description: Participant package for blind fatigue-life prediction of 42CrMo4+QT steel under multiaxial high-cycle loading. It includes rules, calibration data, load cases, specimen information and submission templates.

title: Dataset for: "Fatigue assessment of sharp notches under Mode I and Mode III loading by means of a process volume based critical plane approach"
description: Research data associated with sharp-notch fatigue under Mode I and Mode III loading. The record has restricted files; consult the landing page for access information.

title: Dataset for: "Fatigue assessment of welded joints subjected to multiaxial loading conditions through the Effective Critical Plane approach"
description: Experimental fatigue-life data and ECP predictions for welded joints under uniaxial and multiaxial loading. Individual text files distinguish geometry, loading, treatment and load ratio.
scope_note: Supporting data; Zenodo labels this record as Journal. It is listed here separately from the associated journal article.

title: Dataset for: "Application of the Effective Critical Plane approach for the fatigue assessment of ductile cast iron under multiaxial and non-proportional loading conditions"
description: Raw and processed ductile cast iron fatigue data supporting ECP assessment under multiaxial and non-proportional loading, including experimental life, damage parameter and predicted life.
scope_note: Supporting data; Zenodo labels this record as Data paper. It is listed here separately from the associated journal article.

title: Dataset for: "Fatigue assessment of structural components through the Effective Critical Plane factor"
description: ECP post-processing of published En3B low-carbon steel fatigue experiments, supporting the comparison of fatigue predictions for notched components.

title: Tensile tests on PEEL and LAP hybrid self-pierce riveting joints with and without adhesive
description: Experimental time, displacement and force measurements from tensile tests on PEEL and LAP hybrid self-piercing riveted joints, with and without adhesive.

title: Dataset of dimensionless operating conditions for welding and metal additive manufacturing
access_label: Public record; consult repository for file access
description: Dimensionless operating conditions accompanying research on the Rosenthal solution for welding and metal additive manufacturing.
